meta.title: 在巴塞罗那被偷了。漫游西班牙07。
meta.title_en: Getting Robbed in Barcelona. Roaming Spain 07.
meta.topic: 旅行Vlog · 西班牙 · 巴塞罗那 · 防盗提醒

scenes.title_cn: 开场：所有东西都在这里被偷了
scenes.context: 博主以遗憾开场：今天没有高质量视频和充满能量的博主，因为所有东西都在巴塞罗那被偷了。语域：自嘲式口播。
sentences: 今天没有高质量的视频和充满能量的博主，因为我的所有东西都在这里被偷了。
Today there's no high-quality video and no high-energy host, because everything I had was stolen here.
high-energy host（充满能量的博主）；be stolen（被偷）
你可能以为自驾游就不会被偷东西，不会被抢。
You might think that if you're driving, you won't get robbed or mugged.
get robbed or mugged（被偷被抢）；you might think（你可能以为）
我们就是因为这个才自驾游的，结果还是被偷了，防不胜防。
That's exactly why we drove — but we still got robbed. You can't guard against everything.
that's exactly why（正是因为）；can't guard against everything（防不胜防）
paraphrase: 被偷被抢 → get robbed or mugged / get ripped off
get robbed · get ripped off
防不胜防 → can't guard against everything / there's no defense against it
can't guard against · no defense
scenes.speak: Today there's no high-quality video and no high-energy host, because everything I had was stolen here. You might think that if you're driving, you won't get robbed or mugged. That's exactly why we drove — but we still got robbed. You can't guard against everything.

scenes.title_cn: 高速路上的骗局：假交警
scenes.title_en: The Highway Scam: A Fake Officer
scenes.context: 高速上有一辆车一直逼停博主一家，穿交警工作服的人喊「你的车着火了」，吸引注意后给轮胎放气并让他们等，随后逃跑。语域：惊险叙事。
sentences: 我们刚刚正常在高速路上行驶，然后就有一辆车一直在逼我们，一直把我们逼停。
We were driving normally on the highway when a car kept forcing us to pull over.
force us to pull over（逼我们停车）；drive normally（正常行驶）
他穿着交警的工作服，下来冲着我们一直喊：你的车着火了，你的车着火了。
He was wearing a traffic officer's uniform, got out, and kept shouting at us: your car is on fire, your car is on fire!
traffic officer's uniform（交警工作服）；your car is on fire（你的车着火了）
他吸引了我们三个人的所有注意，然后就指着我们车的屁股后面。
He distracted all three of us and pointed behind our car.
distract（吸引注意力）；point behind the car（指着车后）
paraphrase: 把我们逼停 → force us to pull over / force us to stop
force to pull over · force to stop
你的车着火了 → your car is on fire / your car's burning
on fire · burning
scenes.speak: We were driving normally on the highway when a car kept forcing us to pull over. He was wearing a traffic officer's uniform, got out, and kept shouting at us: your car is on fire, your car is on fire! He distracted all three of us and pointed behind our car.

scenes.context: 假交警给轮胎放气后立刻逃跑，博主起疑，反应过来化妆包和随身包都不见了。设备、化妆品全被抢走。语域：焦虑自白。
sentences: 他说你在这里等着，但他说得非常着急，然后他就立刻跑了。
He told us to wait here, but he said it in a hurry, and then he just ran off.
in a hurry（很着急）；run off（跑掉）
那个人看起来不像解决问题，然后我突然反应过来：我的包呢？
That guy didn't look like he was trying to help, and then it hit me: where's my bag?
it hit me（我突然反应过来）；doesn't look like he's helping（不像在帮忙）
我没有设备，没有化妆品，我真的是想哭哭不出来。
No gear, no makeup — I really wanted to cry but couldn't.
no gear（没设备）；wanted to cry but couldn't（想哭哭不出来）
paraphrase: 突然反应过来 → it hit me / it dawned on me / all of a sudden it clicked
it hit me · dawned on me
想哭哭不出来 → wanted to cry but couldn't / too shocked to cry
wanted to cry · too shocked to cry
scenes.speak: He told us to wait here, but he said it in a hurry, and then he just ran off. That guy didn't look like he was trying to help, and then it hit me: where's my bag? No gear, no makeup — I really wanted to cry but couldn't.

scenes.context: 博主报警，警察说必须去警局报案，但车胎没气走不了；警察让他们联系保险公司，没人能帮。语域：无助叙事。
sentences: 打电话报警，报警警察不理你，他说你得先到警察局报案。
We called the police, but they wouldn't help over the phone — we had to file a report at the station first.
file a report at the station（到警局报案）
我说我报不了案，我的轮胎没有气了。
I said I couldn't file a report because my tire had no air.
my tire had no air（轮胎没气）
他说那你打电话给你的保险公司吧，我们帮不了你。
He said, then call your insurance company — we can't help you.
insurance company（保险公司）；we can't help you（我们帮不了你）
paraphrase: 到警局报案 → file a report at the station / report it to the police in person
file a report · report in person
轮胎没气 → my tire had no air / the tire was flat
tire had no air · flat tire
scenes.speak: We called the police, but they wouldn't help over the phone — we had to file a report at the station first. I said I couldn't file a report because my tire had no air. He said, then call your insurance company — we can't help you.

scenes.context: 补好胎后继续上路，看到真的交警也心有余悸；妈妈出门非要背两个包，把信用卡手机分开放，只求被抢一个还留一个。语域：苦笑+生活细节。
sentences: 我妈PTSD了，这里有个真的交警给我们指路，我们还不理他。
My mom's got PTSD — a real officer was giving us directions, and we ignored him.
got PTSD（心理创伤后遗症，口语夸张）；ignore someone（不理某人）
她说我两个信用卡、两个手机放在不同的包里，只要她抢我一个包，我还有另一个包。
She says she splits her credit cards and phones between two bags — so if they grab one, she still has the other.
split ... between two bags（把…分放在两个包里）
我最喜欢的裙子都留给巴塞罗那了。
My favorite dress was left behind in Barcelona.
be left behind（留在）；favorite dress（最喜欢的裙子）
paraphrase: 分开放 → split ... between two bags / keep them in separate places
split between · separate places
心有余悸 → got PTSD / still shaken / on edge
got PTSD · still shaken
scenes.speak: My mom's got PTSD — a real officer was giving us directions, and we ignored him. She says she splits her credit cards and phones between two bags — so if they grab one, she still has the other. My favorite dress was left behind in Barcelona.

scenes.title_cn: 巴特罗之家：海洋与高迪
scenes.context: 博主带妈妈去巴特罗之家——富商巴特罗请高迪改造自己的家，整栋住宅以海洋为主题；街上富商攀比请不同建筑师改造，形成「不和谐街区」。语域：建筑讲解。
sentences: 巴特罗之家就是仿制富商巴特罗请高迪来改造自己的家，整栋住宅都以海洋为主题。
Casa Batlló is the home businessman Batlló had Gaudí remodel, with the whole house themed around the ocean.
have Gaudí remodel（请高迪改造）；themed around the ocean（以海洋为主题）
这条街上的富商都为了攀比，请来不同的建筑师改造房子，风格一个比一个夸张。
The rich merchants on this street competed to hire different architects, each house more extravagant than the last.
compete to hire（争相聘请）；more extravagant than the last（一个比一个夸张）
所以最后这里就被叫做不和谐街区。
So the street came to be called the Block of Discord.
the Block of Discord（不和谐街区）
paraphrase: 请人改造 → have ... remodel / hire ... to renovate
have remodel · hire to renovate
一个比一个夸张 → each more extravagant than the last / each wilder than the last
more extravagant · wilder than the last
scenes.speak: Casa Batlló is the home businessman Batlló had Gaudí remodel, with the whole house themed around the ocean. The rich merchants on this street competed to hire different architects, each house more extravagant than the last. So the street came to be called the Block of Discord.

scenes.title_en: Sagrada Família: A Cathedral in a Forest
scenes.context: 博主介绍圣家堂并非传统哥特式：高迪不喜欢外部的飞扶壁，把柱子设计成树的结构向上分岔撑起屋顶，让光线透过彩色玻璃照进来。语域：建筑讲解。
sentences: 传统哥特式建筑通常需要在外墙上加上一排的飞扶壁，也就是从外墙把墙体和拱顶给撑住。
Traditional Gothic buildings usually need a row of flying buttresses on the outside to prop up the walls and vault.
flying buttresses（飞扶壁）；prop up（撑住）
高迪觉得这些外部的支撑就像是给建筑架了一排拐杖。
Gaudí thought these external supports were like a row of crutches for the building.
a row of crutches（一排拐杖）
高迪把教堂里的柱子设计成树的结构，让它们向上延伸以后不断分岔，就像树枝一样撑起屋顶。
Gaudí designed the columns like tree trunks that branch upward and spread to hold up the roof.
columns like tree trunks（柱子像树干）；branch upward（向上分岔）
paraphrase: 撑住 → prop up / support / hold up
prop up · hold up
像树一样分岔 → branch like a tree / spread out like branches
branch · spread like branches
scenes.speak: Traditional Gothic buildings usually need a row of flying buttresses on the outside to prop up the walls and vault. Gaudí thought these external supports were like a row of crutches for the building. Gaudí designed the columns like tree trunks that branch upward and spread to hold up the roof.

scenes.title_cn: 结尾：海鲜饭的真相与告别
scenes.title_en: Closing: The Truth About Paella & Goodbye
scenes.context: 博主揭秘：最早的西班牙海鲜饭没有海鲜，是鸡肉兔肉蜗牛豆类混在一起；最后和家人离开充满遗憾的巴塞罗那。语域：趣闻+道别。
sentences: 最早的西班牙海鲜饭是没有海鲜的，就是拿乱七八糟的鸡肉、兔肉、蜗牛什么的豆类混在一起的饭。
The original paella had no seafood — it was a rice dish mixed with whatever was around: chicken, rabbit, snails, and beans.
the original paella（最早的西班牙海鲜饭）；mixed with whatever was around（拿乱七八糟的食材混在一起）
到了后面才有了海鲜，然后被我们翻译成西班牙海鲜饭。
Only later did seafood get added, and then we translated the name into seafood paella.
only later did ...（到了后面才…）；translate the name（翻译名称）
罢了，和这个美丽的地方说再见吧。
Oh well — let's say goodbye to this beautiful place.
oh well（罢了）；say goodbye to（和…说再见）
paraphrase: 到了后面才 → only later did ... / it wasn't until later that ...
only later did · wasn't until later
和…说再见 → say goodbye to / bid farewell to
say goodbye · bid farewell
scenes.speak: The original paella had no seafood — it was a rice dish mixed with whatever was around: chicken, rabbit, snails, and beans. Only later did seafood get added, and then we translated the name into seafood paella. Oh well — let's say goodbye to this beautiful place.

practice: A fake officer pulled us over, said our car was on fire, and stole our bags.
The police said we had to report at the station, but our tire was flat and we couldn't move.
Gaudí shaped the columns like trees instead of using flying buttresses.
The original paella had no seafood — just chicken, rabbit, snails, and beans.
pitfalls: The car is burning on fire.
on fire 已是「着火」，burning on fire 重复冗余。
He stole my bag, I was very angry.
It hit me: where's my bag?
表达「突然反应过来」用 it hit me / it dawned on me，比 I was very angry 更有画面。
I couldn't file a report because my tire was flat.
file a report（报案）是固定搭配，不能漏 a；补充原因更完整。
Gaudí designed the cathedral with tree-like columns.
build 的过去式是 built 不是 builded；且用 designed 更准确。
shifts: 用 get robbed（被抢）、get scammed（被骗）、fall for a trick（中圈套）
用 cathedral、flying buttresses、columns、vault、facade 等建筑术语
用 wanted to cry but couldn't、heartbroken、devastated、down
